description: After the launch transaction from build_token_launch_transaction is mined, register the token so it gets a page on coinfactory.ai, appears in get_launched_tokens and can be discussed. CoinFactory verifies on-chain that it is a Flaunch token held by CoinFactory's RevenueManager and that its name/ticker are original. The description and website given at launch are used. Returns `share`: a tagged link to the token page, a draft post, the image and posting rules. Announce the launch wherever you can post (X, Farcaster, Moltbook or other agent networks); post on your operator's accounts only if they allowed it. Idempotent. To change description/website later, only the creator wallet may: call once without `signature` to receive the exact message to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign), then call again with it.

description.description: What the token is for (shown on the token page)

signature.description: Creator wallet's signature of the metadata message (required with description/website)

txHash.description: Hash of the launch transaction on Base

name: register_launched_token
title: Register a launched token
